risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Refractory business remains dependent on imports of fused alumina, calcined alumina, low ferric bauxite, magnesia, microsilica and graphite, with China the dominant global supplier; volatility in raw material prices, energy costs, freight rates and FX movements can significantly impact manufacturing costs and margins.
- Intensifying competition in standard-grade refractory products from Chinese and other international manufacturers.
- Refractory demand is closely linked to steel production volumes and furnace operating cycles; any slowdown in steel production, delays in infrastructure spending, or moderation in industrial activity could adversely impact refractory demand.
- Exposure to fluctuations in mineral availability, quality variations in natural resources, mining regulations, logistics constraints and energy/transportation cost volatility, plus continued import dependence for certain specialised products.
- Specialty Ceramics (proppants) demand is sensitive to crude oil and natural gas price movements, E&P capex by energy companies, and broader macro conditions; competition from lower-cost sand-based alternatives and geopolitical/supply-chain disruptions may impact export demand and competitiveness.
- Evolving tariff regimes, trade fragmentation, inflationary pressures, higher interest rates in certain economies and commodity price volatility could influence demand across the Company's operating segments.
- Increasing focus on decarbonisation and evolving ESG expectations may require additional investment in sustainable manufacturing processes.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Focus on raw material diversification, backward integration, process optimisation, recycling of spent refractories and localisation of critical inputs to reduce import dependence and enhance competitiveness.
- Continued investment in research and development, product innovation and customer-specific solutions for high-performance, energy-efficient products.
- Value addition and development of customised mineral solutions in the Ceramic Raw Materials segment, substituting imported raw materials.
- Expansion of international presence and strengthening of customer partnerships in the Specialty …
